channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Candidatos de direita falam em 'pizza' após pedido de vista de Dino no STF
item.description: Right-wing candidates and figures used the term 'pizza' to criticize Supreme Court President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva after the extraordinary session was closed following a request for adjournment by Alexandre de Moraes. The reaction occurred after a session addressing the constitutionality of public security laws.

item.title: 'Não tem trégua, precisa investigar todos', diz Lula sobre ministros do STF
item.description: Lula calls for investigating all Supreme Court justices involved in the Master case and advocates for judicial reform in an interview with Record.

item.title: Condenados da lista de Vorcaro “não merecem voto”, diz Cury
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) stated that voters should not support politicians linked to Daniel Vorcaro's investigations if they are convicted. The remarks were made during a campaign event on Avenida Paulista while the STF discussed opening investigations. The candidate used the issue to criticize corruption and reinforce his anti-corruption stance.

item.title: Tarcísio suspende agenda de campanha em São Paulo após fortes chuvas
item.description: Governor and candidate Tarcísio de Freitas suspended his campaign schedule in São Paulo following heavy rains that left three dead and two missing. The Civil Defense served roughly 2,000 people in the affected region, while Tarcísio prioritized government action and distributed over 7,000 support items. The campaign stated activities will resume as soon as the emergency situation allows.

item.title: O motivo que fez Tarcísio de Freitas congelar as agendas de campanha
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas paused his campaign to focus on responding to heavy rains affecting the state. The government sent medical supplies, humanitarian aid, and a mobile Poupatempo unit to assist affected residents. Campaign activities will resume only if the weather stabilizes.

item.title: Dino pede que STF acione Lula e Itamaraty sobre sanções dos EUA
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino suggested that the STF send a statement to President Lula and the Foreign Minister regarding US threats to sanction Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The proposal was made during the Banco Master case trial, as Minister Cármen Lúcia rejected external pressures, defending judicial independence. The case involves investigations into alleged irregularities by Moraes with Daniel Vorcaro and million-dollar contracts with his wife's law firm.

item.title: STF encerra sessão de caso Moraes sem definição; Dino tem 90 dias para ficar com processo
item.description: The STF closed the session on the Moraes case without a ruling, after Justice Flávio Dino requested more time and signaled concern over the 2026 elections. The session was marked by conflicts among justices, failing to resolve even the order-of-business issue raised by Gilmar Mendes.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia se diz “envergonhada” com atual situação do STF
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia expressed embarrassment over the institutional crisis involving the Court and election-related rulings, criticizing external and internal pressures influencing judicial decisions.

item.title: Caso Moraes: 2ª parte da live do STF chega a 179,5 mil aparelhos
item.description: The second part of the live stream covering Alexandre de Moraes' trial at the STF reached 179,500 simultaneous devices, below the 194,500 peak of the morning session. Justices Flávio Dino and Luiz Fux debated the case's rapporteur and investigation procedures, reflecting disagreements over the adopted legal proceedings. The broadcast accumulated 1.2 million views over 7h48min.

item.title: No STF, Dino insinua que Fux recebeu mensagem de Vorcaro; ministro nega
item.description: Justice Flávio Dino suggested that Justice Luiz Fux exchanged messages with banker Daniel Vorcaro, and hinted other justices were also involved. Fux denied having any contact. The clash unfolded during a session analyzing an inquiry into alleged messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Caiado diz que STF "perdeu o rumo" após sessão marcada por bate-bocas
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado harshly criticized the STF after a session marked by heated arguments between justices, stating the institution 'lost its way'. The candidate called the episode a 'degrading spectacle' that embarrasses the country and defended the immediate removal of Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Os próximos passos no STF sobre os pedidos de investigação contra Moraes e Mendonça
item.description: Following a tense session at the Supreme Federal Court, Minister Flávio Dino requested a hold on deciding whether to merge investigations into Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça, with a 90-day deadline. The full bench voted 4 to 3 in favor of separating the cases, delaying the merits review. Moraes also released a written defense denying any wrongdoing, and related hearings were suspended.

item.title: ‘Sem presidente, sem comando’, ironiza Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used his free electoral time to mock the STF, claiming 'no president, no command' and blaming the federal government for an alleged imbalance of powers. The criticism came hours after a unprecedented court session. The senator and presidential candidate seized the moment to attack the administration and the Judiciary.

item.title: STF deixa destino de Moraes em suspenso, mas revela cenário favorável à vitória do ministro
item.description: The STF session ended without a concrete decision but signals a favorable scenario for Alexandre de Moraes if investigated, due to a tie among ministers and the rule favoring the defendant. The case involves alleged irregularities in the PF report and a link to Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: “Isso aqui virou um não país”, diz Renan Santos sobre STF
item.description: Missão à Presidência candidate Renan Santos criticized the partial outcome of Tuesday’s session on the Moraes-Vorcaro case, which maintained issues involving Justice Alexandre de Moraes. He described the 4-3 result as a “terrible mess” and said the country had become “a no-country.” The remark underscores Renan’s criticism of the STF and Moraes.

item.title: Pedido de desculpas de Cármen deveria ser compartilhado pelos colegas
item.description: The column praises Cármen Lúcia's apology to the public but criticizes the unproductive STF session and argues that the other justices should have shared responsibility. It accuses Alexandre de Moraes, Gilmar Mendes and Flávio Dino of disrupting the debate and diverting attention from the possible investigation into contacts with Daniel Vorcaro, while mapping internal court alignments.

item.title: Helder lidera pesquisa para o Senado no PA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll released on September 15, 2026, shows Helder Barbalho (MDB) leading Senate race intentions in Pará with 36%. Delegate Éder Mauro (PL), Chicão (União Brasil), and Zequinha Marinho (Podemos) follow in a technical tie at 16%, 13%, and 13% respectively.

item.title: Renan Santos critica sessão do STF sobre Moraes: "Que pizza horrorosa"
item.description: Renan Santos criticized the STF session on Moraes, calling it a 'horrible pizza'. The session decided to analyze Moraes and Mendonça cases separately, with 4 votes to 3, and was suspended after Flávio Dino requested a vote.

item.title: Para ministros de Lula, Moraes saiu enfraquecido de sessão do STF
item.description: Lula's ministers assess that Alexandre de Moraes left the STF session weakened after failing to get a majority against an investigation request in the Master Case. The partial vote was 4-3 to reject the procedural motion, and Moraes is expected to lack a majority on the merits too. Edson Fachin was praised for steering the session and countering Moraes's maneuvers.

item.title: Janja adesiva carros, canta jingle de Lula e ignora perguntas sobre caso Moraes
item.description: Janja attended a campaign sticker event for Lula's reelection in Brasília and avoided questions about the STF crisis involving Moraes. Lula allies call the investigation request a 'necessary evil,' while Lula only addressed the issue later via TV interview.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia pede desculpas e diz que STF provocou ‘mal-estar cívico’ no País
item.description: Justice Cármen Lúcia apologized to the country for the civic unrest caused by public frictions among Supreme Court ministers, stating the Court should have acted to prevent the situation. She voted against merging petitions involving Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça in the Banco Master case, alongside Edson Fachin, Mendonça and Fux, and criticized the PGR's authority to request case closures as authoritarian.

item.title: 'Monstro do impeachment', Fachin sob ataque e 'STF sangrando': como os colunistas do GLOBO avaliaram sessão sobre Moraes
item.description: The STF voted to consider Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça separately after a police report named Moraes as a possible contact of banker Daniel Vorcaro. Flávio Dino's request to review the case delayed a final ruling until after the election, keeping the institutional crisis and political disputes active.

item.title: Teatro no Supremo expõe disfunção e impacto eleitoral
item.description: The Supreme Court session regarding the connection between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro was marked by Carmen Lucia's absence, as she refused to take part. The episode underscores institutional strain and judicial tensions that may shape the 2026 electoral landscape.

item.title: 'Profunda consternação' e 'mal-estar cívico': veja as principais falas de Carmen Lúcia em julgamento de Moraes no STF
item.description: During the STF session on the investigation involving Moraes, Carmen Lúcia voted to separate the cases of Moraes and André Mendonça, expressing deep consternation and warning about the civic unrest caused by the judicial crisis, apologizing for not having helped calm the political situation.

item.title: Hana tem 42% contra 36% de Dr. Daniel no 2º turno do PA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A polling firm Real Time Big Data survey, registered with the TSE, shows Pará Governor Hana Ghassan (MDB) leading with 42% of voting intentions against 36% for Dr. Daniel (Podemos) in a potential runoff. Blank, null, and spoiled votes account for 9%, while 13% of respondents did not know or did not answer. The survey was conducted between September 10–14, 2026, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a budget of R$20,000, sponsored by Record TV.

item.title: Supremo salva Alexandre de Moraes por até 90 dias
item.description: The STF postponed for up to 90 days the possible investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes regarding his ties with Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master arrested on corruption suspicion. This follows a request for further review by Minister Flávio Dino, during a session marked by intense disputes and mutual accusations among ministers, including Gilmar Mendes and André Mendonça, over an order of business issue. Gilmar Mendes proposed the joint handling of PECs 16.662 and 16.704, but the vote ended in a tie with no immediate resolution.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que quem está na lista de Vorcaro e for condenado 'não merece voto'
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury stated during a campaign event that convicted politicians linked to Daniel Vorcaro should not receive votes. He also advocated for swift trials, reduced interest rates, and an audit of public spending to address family debt.

item.title: Ministério atua para que Redata permita o uso de gás natural
item.description: The Ministry of Mines and Energy (MME) and other federal agencies are working to allow the use of natural gas for data centers seeking tax incentives under the Redata regime, following the bill's enactment by President Lula on September 15, 2026. The pending regulation faces internal resistance but may impose conditions such as carbon credit purchases to offset emissions.

item.title: Flávio fala de crise no STF em propaganda eleitoral com vídeo em formato de 'pronunciamento'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used electoral advertising to comment on the STF crisis involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes, released the same day as an unprecedented session on the minister's future. The video was structured as a pronouncement, highlighting institutional tension. The approach reflects a strategy of using judicial themes to gain visibility in the campaign.

item.title: Lula resiste à crise do STF e Flávio Bolsonaro vai para a defensiva
item.description: Lula holds firm amid STF criticisms, while Flávio Bolsonaro takes a defensive stance over investigations. Institutional tension escalates as 2026 elections approach.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia diz estar ‘envergonhada’ com crise no STF e pede desculpas ao país
item.description: Cármen Lúcia, a minister of the STF, expressed shame over the crisis in the court and apologized to the country, highlighting concern with the impact on the election. During the trial of Alexandre de Moraes, she criticized the dramatization of the cases and the destabilization caused by the tribunal, especially on the eve of the elections.

item.title: Zanin vota a favor de questão de ordem para redistribuir processo sobre Moraes
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin voted in favor of suspending the trial regarding an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, preventing a decision on alleged ties with Daniel Vorcaro. The vote keeps the case ongoing without an immediate conclusion.

item.title: Para Planalto, Lula perde com crise e melhor cenário é investigar Moraes
item.description: The STF crisis hurts Lula's campaign, which faces a scenario with no favorable resolution for reelection. The Planalto strategy points to investigating Moraes as the only viable exit.

item.title: Mendonça acompanha Fachin, e placar vai a 4 a 2 sobre rito do caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Minister André Mendonça aligned with Edson Fachin's vote, leading to a 4-2 majority in favor of Gilmar Mendes's proposal to merge petitions 16,662 and 16,704 at the STF. The case involves complex legal discussions with procedural implications.

item.title: PRTB troca Marçal por Leonardo Avalanche na disputa à Presidência
item.description: The PRTB replaced Pablo Marçal with Leonardo Avalanche in the presidential race after the TSE rejected Marçal's candidacy due to party affiliation irregularities and ineligibility until 2032. Avalanche, the party's national president, took over the ticket and now runs with Silvia Helena da Silva Pereira as vice-presidential candidate.

item.title: Demanda por crédito subiu até 38% em faixa de renda que daria vitória a Lula
item.description: Credit demand grew 17.1% over 12 months through July, with a 38.8% increase among consumers earning one to two minimum wages, the income bracket where Lula leads voter intentions against Flavio Bolsonaro. The high demand for resources is linked to a heavy income burden from basic bills, reaching 87% among the poorest.

item.title: Lula tem 44% contra 37% de Flávio no 2º turno no PA, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data released on September 15, 2026, shows that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 44% of voting intentions in a potential second round of the presidential elections in Pará, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 37%. The survey interviewed 1,600 voters between September 10 and 14, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 60% e desaprovado por 38% em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows that 60% of Pernambuco voters approve of Lula's (PT) work, while 38% disapprove. The poll interviewed 1,600 voters from September 10 to 14, 2026, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level, registered with the TSE.

item.title: Lula tem 59% contra 36% de Flávio no 2º turno em PE, diz pesquisa
item.description: A poll by Real Time Big Data, released on September 15, 2026, shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 59% of voting intentions in the 2nd round of the presidential election in Pernambuco, against 36% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). In the 1st round, Lula has 56%, while Flávio has 25%. The poll surveyed 1,600 voters between September 10 and 14, with a 2-point margin of error, and was funded by Record.

item.title: Eleições: prazo para troca de candidatos se encerrou na segunda
item.description: The deadline for candidate substitutions in the 2026 elections ended on September 14, allowing changes only in case of death after that period. Some Senate candidates, such as Aécio Neves and Renan Calheiros, made substitutions within the legal deadline. In the presidential race, the TSE rejected Pablo Marçal's registration due to irregularities, with no replacement.

item.title: Senador aciona STF para pressionar Alcolumbre a instalar CPI do Master
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) filed a writ of mandamus at the Supreme Court to pressure the President of the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), to install the CPI of Banco Master, investigating the relationship of ministers with Daniel Vorcaro. The action aims to push for the opening of the commission, which has been stalled for six months, with 41 supporting signatures. The matter involves alleged irregularities concerning high court justices and the national financial system.

item.title: Possível blindagem a Moraes aproxima campanhas de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Investigations involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes may serve as bargaining chip between the campaigns of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, leading to unexpected alliances. The 2026 electoral landscape could see coalitions formed around shared interests to counteract Supreme Court pressures.

item.title: Defesa usará impedimento de Nunes Marques para questionar prisão de Vorcaro
item.description: The defense of Daniel Vorcaro intends to use Justice Nunes Marques' recusal to challenge the arrest of the banker, arguing inconsistency in the 2026 Second Chamber session. Marques voted to uphold the arrest but did not declare himself impartial, unlike Justice Toffoli, who recused himself due to suspected bias.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula ‘dividiu seu poder’ com Moraes em programa eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate from PL, criticized President Lula and Minister Alexandre de Moraes during free electoral time, accusing the PT leader of sharing power with the STF and leaving Brazil without leadership. He also referenced the investigation into the funding of the film 'Dark Horse,' which involves him and banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral suspende propaganda de André do Prado com Tarcísio
item.description: The Electoral Justice suspended André do Prado's campaign ad that featured Tarcísio de Freitas for more than the allowed 25% of airtime. Judge Domitlica Manssur ruled that the integration of images and the musical jingle excessively praised the governor, exceeding the legal limit of 7.5 seconds. The decision followed a lawsuit by Fernando Haddad's coalition, imposing a R$10,000 fine for any further unauthorized broadcasts.

item.title: Zanin aponta “inversão de lógica” no caso Moraes-Vorcaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cristiano Zanin supported a procedural objection raised by Gilmar Mendes regarding the Moraes-Vorcaro case, arguing that analyzing an investigation before deciding on recusal would be a logical inversion.

item.title: 'Até a máfia tem ética': Veja frases marcantes da sessão do STF que discute futuro de Moraes
item.description: The STF holds a session to discuss the future of Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case, with direct confrontations between justices regarding judicial decisions and impacts on public security. The deliberations reflect institutional tensions and debates about the role of the judiciary in conducting sensitive investigations.

item.title: Renan Filho tem 47% contra 43% de JHC no 2º turno em AL, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data survey shows Renan Filho (MDB) leading with 47% against JHC (PSDB) at 43% in a potential runoff for the 2026 Alagoas gubernatorial race. The poll, registered with the TSE under AL-09248/2026, interviewed 1,600 voters from September 10 to 14, 2026, with a margin of error of 2 percentage points and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Presidenciáveis se manifestam sobre sessão do STF que discute investigação de Moraes
item.description: Presidential candidates commented on the historic STF session regarding the investigation of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, criticizing judicial overreach and supporting court reforms. Caiado and Zema backed Moraes' removal, while Lula remained silent.

item.title: Dino e Fux divergem sobre o que já foi feito no caso Moraes
item.description: During the STF hearing regarding an investigation involving Minister Alexandre de Moraes, Flávio Dino and Luiz Fux disagreed on whether a formal inquiry had been opened. Fux claimed no formal investigation existed yet, while Dino implied procedures were already underway.
